finding.claim: The demo's index explicitly says no real AI is running, chat responses are pre-made, logs are from real sessions and the Swarm visualization runs in-browser. logs.js itself labels the page as real Frank logs plus a simulated live feed. Therefore embedded log presentation has mixed provenance even when individual REAL_LOGS entries are source-asserted as captured from journald.
finding.constraint: No original journald file, source hash, host identity or capture receipt was recovered in this bounded demo shard, so embedded REAL_LOGS entries are historical observational candidates, not independently verified runtime evidence.
finding.implication: Ingestion must preserve per-record provenance class and never let display-layer labels such as REAL_LOGS upgrade evidence authority. Any reuse in benchmarks/training requires source labels; scientific promotion requires original log/hash ancestry.
